topic: Analyzing German box locations and calibration
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on analyzing the behavior and potential issues of specific advertising box locations in Germany (Germany boxes). A list of problematic boxes was shared via a document link. Someone requested assistance identifying other remaining boxes that are similar to two specified locations: JCD_DE_120804 and JCD_DE_120848, particularly concerning their environment and proximity.

[me] inquired whether the calibration or factor for JCD_DE_120804 and JCD_DE_120848 had changed since November. It was noted that no changes were made to the model, but the calibration was updated to a 40-meter radius during a model release. The closest suggested matches were provided: 120885 (near 12084) and 122480 (near 120848).
decisions: Identified potential similar box locations near JCD_DE_120804 and JCD_DE_120848.
action_items: Someone needs to review the suggested boxes (120885, 122480) for similarity to the target locations.
Review historical calibration changes for specific German box IDs.
